question.knowledge_point: Finding the Vector Equation of a Straight Line Given Parametrically
question.problem:
Consider the straight line given by the following parametric equations:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}x=5 \\ y=4t \\ z=7\end{aligned}
$$

What would be the vector equation of the line?
question.worked_solution:
These parametric equations are equivalent to

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 4t \\ 7\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 0 \\ 7\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 4t \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 0 \\ 7\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 4 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\ r & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 0 \\ 7\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 4 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\end{aligned}
$$

where $t\in (-\infty ,\infty ).$
